item.text: tit_for_tat Cooperate initially, then mirror the opponent’s most recent action. This preserves mutual cooperation with cooperative opponents while immediately retaliating against defection, avoiding the permanent overreaction of the current history-wide trigger. ```python # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def policy(own_history, opponent_history): return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else opponent_history[-1] # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END ```
